rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the heel at the back of the foot.

example.english: The new shoes rubbed my heel until it hurt.
example.traditional: 我隻腳踭畀新鞋磨到好痛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 zaang1 bei2 san1 haai4 mo4 dou3 hou2 tung3

rows.note: Use this for the whole high-heeled shoe, rather than just the heel part of a shoe.

example.english: I have to wear a shoe with a high heel at tomorrow’s wedding banquet.
example.traditional: 聽日婚宴，我要着高踭鞋。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 fan1 jin3 ngo5 jiu3 zoek3 gou1 zaang1 haai4

rows.note: Use this for the heel part of an ordinary shoe, rather than for a high-heeled shoe as a whole.

example.english: The heel of these sneakers has worn flat.
example.traditional: 呢對波鞋嘅鞋踭磨平咗。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi3 bo1 haai4 ge3 haai4 zaang1 mo4 peng4 zo2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the heel section of a sock or similar foot covering.

example.english: The heel of my sock has developed a hole.
example.traditional: 我隻襪嘅襪踭穿咗個窿。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 mat6 ge3 mat6 zaang1 cyun1 zo2 go3 lung1
